newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Morococha soars on Phelps Dodge purchase.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Morococha soars on Phelps Dodge purchase.

text.p: Morococha stock soared ten percent by midsession Wednesday on the Lima Stock Exchange after Phelps Dodge Corp bought a 27 percent stake in the miner Tuesday.
Two hours and 50 minutes into trade Wednesday, Morococha had climbed 10.07 percent to 3.17 soles in strong volume of 792,000 shares, preliminary bolsa figures showed.

Morococha officials confirmed Tuesday's purchase announced by Phelps in Phoenix, Arizona. The giant miner bought up 40 percent of one stakeholder's share in the Lima blue chip to acquire an indirect economic interest in the Peruvian miner, Morococha said.
"The indirect entry of Phelps Dodge into Morococha is pushing up the share price of this miner," Manuel Torres of local brokerage Finvest said.

Last week, the Peruvian polymetallic miner, whose full name is Compaa Minera San Ignacio de Morococha SA, reported a first quarter net profit of 4.0 million soles, compared to 2.4 million soles in the January to March period 1996.
Phelps Dodge is one of the world's largest copper producers, employing more than 16,000 people in 26 countries, the U.S. miner said in a statement.
